summary: Full first-pass E2E test of AlloyOS. Backend: created /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (28 pytest cases covering auth/register/login/me, departments, employees (AI+human) CRUD, projects, task->real LLM run->review->approval (approve + reject + re-run), events (status/envelope), messaging/conversations/notifications, dashboard stats, multi-tenant isolation) — 28/28 passing. Real Gemini LLM output confirmed (589-char structured output, no [AI execution error]). Frontend: Playwright flows verified login, register-new-company, dashboard stats + live activity, create AI agent from template, Assign & Run from agent panel, New Task dialog with AI assignee, task auto-transition to Review, review modal with real LLM output, Approve->Completed, Reject->Assigned, invite human employee, project creation, department creation, messaging send/thread, 3D Office canvas + character labels, logout, and tenant isolation in UI (fresh company sees only its CEO, no agents/tasks). No blocking bugs found.

minor.issue: No idempotency guard: an already approved/rejected approval can be decided again, re-incrementing agent stats.completed and re-completing the task.
Returns 200 for non-existent ids (PUT returns null body, DELETE returns {ok:true}); should be 404.

from_employee/to_employee are not validated to belong to the caller's company (deliver_message looks up employees without company_id filter), so a foreign employee id is accepted and its name leaks into activity/notification text.
with_employee/employee are ignored unless BOTH are supplied; a single param silently returns all company messages.

ui_bugs.issue: Typo in toast copy: 'Task rejectd' (should be 'Task rejected')
React console error: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' (dynamic expression wrapper inside <option>). Use a single template string child, e.g. {`${x.name} · ${x.role}`}
Template buttons had no data-testid — added data-testid="template-{key}" (fix applied by tester)

issues: Two stray floating horizontal bars (green and orange) render in the empty space above the floor in every company — look like detached/mis-positioned neon trim geometry, visible in both a 12-employee and a 2-employee office.
HUD only counts 'Working'; an agent in 'Waiting' state shows a purple label above the desk but is not summarized in the HUD.
The 'conversation list' is actually the full employee list (no last-message preview / recency ordering), so duplicate-named seeded employees look confusing.

action_items: Fix 'Task rejectd' typo in Tasks.jsx toast.
Add idempotency guard in /api/approvals/{id}/decision (reject decisions on non-pending approvals).
Return 404 for PUT/DELETE /api/employees/{id} when the employee does not exist.
Scope message from/to employee lookups to company_id in deliver_message / POST /api/messages.
Fix the stray floating bars in OfficeScene and the <option><span> React warning in Agents.jsx.

Consider splitting server.py (858 lines) into routers (auth, employees, tasks, messaging, ai) and removing dead code: no-op {"$inc": {"stats.completed": 0}} and the unused find_one in create_envelope.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 858 lines — exceeds the 700-line guideline; split into routers/services.
approvals decision endpoint mutates stats without checking current approval status (double-approve inflates agent completion stats).
CORS is configured with allow_credentials=True and default allow_origins='*' — invalid combination for credentialed requests; app currently relies on Bearer headers, but set explicit origins.
FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') is deprecated — migrate to lifespan.

CreateAgentDialog offers models 'gemini-3.1-pro-preview', 'gpt-5.4-mini', 'claude-sonnet-4-6'; only the default gemini-3-flash-preview was verified end-to-end. Non-default choices are unverified and would surface as '[AI execution error]' text saved into the task output rather than an error state.
run_agent_task swallows LLM errors into the task output string; consider a dedicated 'error' task status so the UI can show a failure state instead of an approval containing an error message.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (1 cosmetic typo, 1 React warning, 3D visual glitch)

seed_data_creation: Demo company (demo@alloy.os) now contains TEST_/QA_ artifacts: agents TEST_Aria + 'QA Scout', humans TEST_Human + 'QA Hooman', projects TEST_Launch + 'QA Project X', dept 'QA Ops'/'TEST_Legal', tasks TEST_*/QA_UI/QA_DLG. Also registered throwaway companies (test_qa_*, test_iso_*, qa_reg_*@qamail.example.com / qapass1234) for isolation tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run backend regression with: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/backend_test.py (pytest.ini forces -n 2 --dist loadscope; use -n 0 for serial, NOT -p no:xdist). Emails must use a real-looking domain (EmailStr rejects .test/.local) and backend lowercases emails. Shared resources are created by session fixtures ai_agent/human_emp/project; class-scoped `state` dict carries task/approval ids inside TestTaskAIChain. AI runs finish in ~5-10s. Frontend testids are complete; template buttons now have data-testid="template-{key}".
rca_of_the_issue: No functional defect found in the core AI chain. The only tester-side fixes were test-data email domains (Pydantic EmailStr rejects reserved .test TLD), case-insensitive email assertion (backend intentionally lowercases), xdist-safe fixtures instead of module-level pytest attributes, and a missing data-testid on the agent template buttons.
